verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs publishes an API reference for Scribe's speech-to-text convert endpoint. It documents parameters such as diarization threshold, timestamp granularity, export formats, async webhooks and auth tokens, plus HTTP/WebSocket support and official Python and Node.js SDKs. Probes confirm the docs are publicly reachable, including machine-readable llms.txt and markdown pages. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
